propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly assert that --force on transition/claim operations is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting shipped code.
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinded the CLI-only policy and made --force available on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with auditability provided by the absence of a signed attestation.
MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py were already updated to reflect the new force-everywhere + absent-attestation model, but the canonical prose documentation has not been corrected.
Stale passages must be rewritten to document that forced writes produce no certification and projects enforce gate checks via CI certification validation.
Out-of-scope CLI-only statements (--allow-secret-pattern, bridge setup wizard, release-notes) must remain unchanged to preserve their distinct semantics.
